blocks.content: Write a program to create a new list from an existing list using list slicing.

items: Create a list named my_list with items 'p','r','o','g','r','a','m','i','z'.
Use the slicing notation to get a new list from the second to the second-last items from my_list.

blocks.content: Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
Hello, there! The challenge is asking you to use list slicing to create a new list from the elements of my_list.
More specifically, you need to create a new list starting from the second element of my_list (given by the index 1) to the second-last element (given by the index -1).
Thus, you need to replace the following lines of your code:

# create a new list using the slicing notation

my_list.sort()


# print the new list

print(my_list)

# create a new list using the slicing notation

new_list = my_list[1: -1]


# print the new list

print(new_list)
Here, my_list[1: -1] gives us elements from the second position to the second-last position.
